items.title: 1.8 Na aur Mg ke pani, oxygen aur chlorine se reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.8, printed page 15.

blocks.text: Sodium, group 1 mein, aur magnesium, group 2 mein, dono pani, oxygen aur chlorine se react karte hain, magar har soorat mein sodium zyada reactive metal hai. Un ke reactions, jo agle teen topics mein ek ek kar ke liye gaye hain, period 3 mein dhaati kirdar ka rujhan dikhate hain: sodium, ek valence electron, bare atom aur kam ionization energy ke saath, magnesium se zyada asani se apna electron khota hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen reactions parhne se pehle peshgoi karein ke sodium aur magnesium mein kaun thande pani se tez react karta hai aur kyun.
blocks.explanation: Sodium: yeh magnesium se bara hai, kam pehli ionization energy rakhta hai aur sirf ek electron khona hai, to zyada dhaati aur zyada reactive hai, aur zor se react karta hai jab ke magnesium aahista.

items: Sodium aur magnesium dono pani, oxygen aur chlorine se react karte hain; sodium apne zyada dhaati kirdar ki wajah se zyada reactive hai.
